question_pt: Quais municipios tiveram crescimento de internacoes em todos os anos de 2019 a 2021?
sql: WITH anual AS (SELECT m."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio, m."SG_UF" AS uf, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021 GROUP BY m."NO_MUNICIPIO", m."SG_UF", ano), piv AS (SELECT municipio, uf, SUM(CASE WHEN ano = 2019 THEN total_internacoes ELSE 0 END) AS total_2019, SUM(CASE WHEN ano = 2020 THEN total_internacoes ELSE 0 END) AS total_2020, SUM(CASE WHEN ano = 2021 THEN total_internacoes ELSE 0 END) AS total_2021 FROM anual GROUP BY municipio, uf) SELECT municipio, uf, total_2019, total_2020, total_2021 FROM piv WHERE total_2020 > total_2019 AND total_2021 > total_2020 ORDER BY total_2021 DESC LIMIT 10
